BiblicalUsage: An egg is a small, plain thing, and Scripture uses it four times, always as a picture of something easily taken. Deuteronomy 22:6 protects the nest with its eggs, Isaiah 10:14 pictures Assyria gathering the riches of the peoples as one gathers eggs left in a nest, and Job 39:14 watches the ostrich leave her eggs in the earth and warm them in the dust.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the egg in these verses is a warning and a comfort at once: what is small and unguarded is easily gathered, and God still tells his people to leave the nest alone.
